thread:
Sam (AE): tagging the team — Acme POC kickoff alignment. Need to lock scope, success criteria, and who does what. 10-week window ok from their side. Can we confirm SE/eng coverage and key milestones?

Priya (SE): I can lead SE. Proposed milestone outline: Week 0 discovery, Week 1 infra + integration, Week 2 eval harness + prompts, Weeks 3-6 tuning, Week 7 scale/load, Week 8 customer validation, Week 9 regression checks, Week 10 final signoff. Need target QPS and sample prompts.

Devon (Eng): we can spare one eng 0.5 FTE first month then 0.25 FTE for maintenance. Need: model pin (e.g., gpt-small-v1 or customer-preferred), sample payloads (50–100 examples), and network diagram for private infra. Also confirm whether Dedicated capacity required.

Alex (Acme): Confirmed 10-week timeline works. Success criteria we care about: p99 latency <500ms for text-gen at typical prompt length (~750 tokens), end-to-end quality >= baseline on our eval set (we'll share), and no P0 security findings. We can deliver 200 sample prompts + 1k conversation snippets by Monday.

Jordan (Security): we'll review Acme's security questionnaire but need early access to the infra diagram and a list of SSO/KMS requirements. DPA + standard SOC attestation fine. If they require IP allowlist or direct peering, that changes timeline by ~2 weeks.

Riley (Solutions): pricing note for the POC: hosted usage discount 40% up to $25k total tokens; if they request Dedicated for predictable latency we'll need a reserved commit — flag to AE. Also flagging that heavy evals (millions of tokens) will be metered.

Priya (SE): SE deliverables: 1) runbook + onboarding checklist (due Wed), 2) eval harness (pytest + prompt set) and pass/fail thresholds (due end of Week 2), 3) weekly demo + metric snapshot. Proposed success thresholds: accuracy >= 85% on key labels, Fallback rate <2%, latency targets met.

Devon (Eng): infra checklist (short): 
- service account + least-priv keys
- model artifact access or model name
- network/firewall + ports for VPC peering
- sample load script (k6/hey)
I'll drop a template in the sales drive.

Sam (AE): action items captured: Priya — runbook + eval harness (due Wed), Devon — infra checklist & quickstart (Mon EOD), Jordan — security review ETA Tue, Alex — share samples by Mon. Weekly sync Wed 9am PT. Can everyone confirm?

Alex (Acme): Confirmed, will share samples Mon morning. Wed 9am works.

Priya (SE): +1. I'll post the runbook link and the eval template before Wed.

Devon (Eng): +1. Allocated engineer is Maya — I'll DM Maya the tasks.

Jordan (Security): +1 — will send request list and expected SLAs we need to see.

Riley (Solutions): noted on pricing. Sam, if they want Dedicated for the stress test, let's flag for procurement early.

Sam (AE): thanks — I'll update the opportunity notes and send calendar invites. If any blockers (legal/peering/pricing) surface, mark as blocker and @me. :thumbsup:
